candidates.title: As wildfires destroy homes, should B.C. make FireSmart principles mandatory?
candidates.description: Experts say practical measures to keep your home from catching fire are proven to work — and point to the communities have built back smarter.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Toxic algae outbreaks in Alberta can now be tracked online through satellite imagery
candidates.description: Blue-green algae is being monitored by researchers across Alberta, and the public can follow along from anywhere through a new website. The Algal Bloom Tracker lets users track toxic algal blooms at six Alberta lakes through satellite imagery, providing near real-time results that can be viewed on a free-to-use map.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'It was unbearable': Halifax tenants call for indoor temperature cap
candidates.description: A recent heat wave has forced tenants to find ways to survive the high temperatures. Some believe the government should limit allowable indoor temperatures for rental units and offer financial aids for cooling methods.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadian men's flag football team earns ticket to LA 2028, where sport will make its Olympics debut
candidates.description: Canada's women's flag football team beat the United States for the world title, while men's squad booked its place at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics on Sunday at the International Federation of American Football (IFAF) world championships in Düsseldorf, Germany.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ontario city needs action on copper wire theft, says frustrated home builder
candidates.description: Allen Wu admits he was naive about what can happen to home building sites in Windsor. But now that his student housing project has been struck by vandals and thieves four times this summer, he and his partners are wondering how such crime is allowed to persist.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: B.C. mayor calls for gang task force support after surge in targeted shootings
candidates.description: Fort St. John Mayor Lilia Hansen wants B.C.'s gang task force to intervene after three shootings in less than a month near local schools.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Consensus reached on proposed corridor for road connecting Nunavut and N.W.T.
candidates.description: The agreement is a step forward towards creating Canada’s first land-based link to Nunavut’s Arctic coast, providing an opportunity for year-round road access to Wekweètì and Gamètì.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Ridiculous, racist' remark leads to member’s exit from Alberta Prosperity Project events
candidates.description: A member of the prominent pro-separation group the Alberta Prosperity Project has “resigned” after he used a racial slur at an event on Thursday where the group presented a draft constitution for an independent Alberta.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'I am tired of being silent:' Hamilton Mayor Andrea Horwath says she left an abusive relationship
candidates.description: In an open letter, Hamilton Mayor Andrea Horwath says she was in an abusive relationship and notes the scrutiny she has faced as a long battle between her, her former partner and the city has publicly unfolded.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Endangered monarch butterflies boom amid wet hot Canadian summer on the Prairies
candidates.description: Monarch butterflies are booming on parts of the Canadian prairie, thanks in part to a wet and hot summer that's produced a healthy population of flowering plants and milkweed that the endangered species depends on.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Petition calls for Canada to officially commemorate soldiers killed in Fenian raids
candidates.description: An obscure battle that took place on Canadian soil just a year before Confederation may not reverberate in the historical consciousness of Canadians outside of the town of Fort Erie, Ont. — but it lays claim to a number of historical focal points.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Pediatricians in Canada warn of 'exponential rise’ in childhood e-scooter injuries
candidates.description: As e-scooters become increasingly common across Canada, pediatricians warn parents and children that e-scooter injuries are often severe and can be deadly.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: After months of debate, East Kootenay will stop changing clocks and stay on mountain daylight time year-round
candidates.description: The Regional District of East Kootenay voted 12-3 to stop changing clocks twice a year and stay on Mountain Daylight Time, keeping the region aligned with Alberta year-round.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Lawn bowling beer garden a 'lifeline' for downtown Guelph, Ont., brewery
candidates.description: Brothers Brewing had to close its patio this summer at 15 Wyndham St. because of a major reconstruction project in downtown Guelph. But a new beer garden at the Guelph Lawn Bowling Club is helping the brewery keep business open for the duration of the construction project while introducing customers to a new sport.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Conservation officers say RCMP weren't mistaken in shooting bear that attacked 3-year-old
candidates.description: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service is apologizing for causing confusion, saying that investigations have revealed RCMP killed the bear that attacked a three-year-old girl in Maple Ridge earlier this month.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: No storm infrastructure issues in St. Catharines before rainstorms led to floods, mayor and experts say
candidates.description: Back-to-back extreme storms have overwhelmed parts of Ontario's Niagara region, flooding homes, farms and businesses. St. Catharines Mayor Mat Siscoe says aging infrastructure is struggling to keep up — and preparing for future floods could cost billions.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Man acquitted of double murder after 40 years reaches settlement with Montreal, Quebec
candidates.description: Claude Paquin, a Quebec man who was wrongfully convicted of a double murder and acquitted 41 years later, has reached a mulitimillion-dollar settlement with Montreal and the provincial government.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Congolese Montreal students face uncertainty over Canada's Ebola travel restrictions
candidates.description: Hundreds of students from countries affected by Canada’s temporary Ebola travel restrictions could face changes to their academic plans as universities prepare for different scenarios.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hawaii faces heavy rain, strong winds as Lala weakens to tropical storm
candidates.description: Hurricane Lala is gradually weakening after the eye of the storm passed the southern tip of Hawaii's Big Island without making landfall, but heavy rainfall could produce flooding and mudslides as more than 130,000 homes are without power.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Thousands evacuated as Indonesia quake death toll rises to 53
candidates.description: Thousands of people have been evacuated after a magnitude-7.7 earthquake hit eastern Indonesia, killing at least 53 people, blocking roads and causing landslides.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Police say 19-year-old arrested in connection with Virginia State University shooting
candidates.description: Police in Virginia say they have arrested a 19-year-old in connection with a shooting on Saturday that left five people injured. No one died in the shooting, but one victim sustained critical injuries.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.K.'s leader calls for reflection after former Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism found dead
candidates.description: A British sociologist who resigned last week from the University of Cambridge following weeks of public accusations of plagiarism and media scrutiny was found dead Friday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Morocco arrests 111 migrants headed to Spain's Ceuta as sides step up crackdown
candidates.description: Moroccan police arrested at least 111 people on Saturday as they tried to enter Spain's North ‌African enclave of Ceuta, amid tightened security on both sides of the border after social media posts called for another mass migrant crossing.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Lala strengthens into hurricane as it barrels toward Hawaii
candidates.description: Hurricane Lala took aim at Hawaii's Big Island on Saturday on a forecast track for possible landfall, which would be the island's first direct hit from a hurricane in 155 years.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon kill 11, Health Ministry says
candidates.description: Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon killed at least 11 people Saturday, in some of the deadliest attacks since a precarious truce between Israel and Hezbollah went into effect in June.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump suggests in speech that 'pretty soon I'll be declaring' Hormuz strait a U.S. territory
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday urged Americans to accept slightly higher gasoline prices as ‌the cost of preventing Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and said he would soon declare the Strait of Hormuz a U.S territory.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Stolen artworks by Cézanne, Matisse and Renoir recovered by Italian police
candidates.description: Italian police have recovered three paintings by ‌French masters Paul Cézanne, Henri Matisse and Pierre-Auguste Renoir that were stolen from a museum near Parma ​in March, officials said on ​Friday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why Trump may struggle to find another Karoline Leavitt | About That
candidates.description: Karoline Leavitt is officially stepping down from her role as White House press secretary. Avneet Dhillon explains how the youngest press secretary in U.S. history helped carry out major changes to media access at the White House and why her combative approach earned her top praise from President Donald Trump. (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadair water-bomber builder feels heat of demand as wildfires rage around the world

candidates.title: Stellantis is considering closing and selling Brampton assembly plant, Unifor says
candidates.description: A national union says it was told by Stellantis this week that it is seriously considering the closure and sale of the Brampton assembly plant. In a statement, Stellantis said its focus remains on finding a sustainable manufacturing solution for the plant.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets

candidates.description: The 19-year-old, who was not a student at the university, was found hiding in a closet on campus, according to police.

candidates.title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North

candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Many Iranians are heading to Turkey to escape the ongoing war's heavy toll

candidates.title: U.S. oil reserves hit the lowest level seen in over 40 years

candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Companies are getting tariff refunds of up to $2 billion from the Trump administration

candidates.title: Why some companies are paying more than $1 million to get through the Panama Canal

candidates.title: 5 exercises that can prevent (and relieve!) pregnancy pain
candidates.description: Hemorrhoids, leg cramps, sciatica — oh my! Alongside the joy of pregnancy often comes a parade of physical discomfort. Alleviate and prevent common aches with these exercises.
